⏺ I'm at the limit again: three PRs waiting for QA and GO, #1002 (KS-1123), #1003 (KS-1165 F-1) and #1004 (KS-932). Since the last update:

  Merged (each on Wednesday's GO, head pinned, verified at origin)
  - #1000 (KS-960) → 4ec051032. KS-960 stays open and is back in Backlog.
  - #999 (KS-1130) → 806869628. KS-1130 is Done.
  - #1001 (KS-1165) → 5b4f38a48. KS-1165 stays open (the gate found two done-criteria only partly met) and is back in Backlog.

  What went wrong and how it was handled
  - Tickets moved by PRs: Linear's GitHub integration moves tickets based on PR wording. Opening #999 moved KS-1129, an unfixed root-cause ticket, to In Progress, because
    my description said "Root fix: KS-1129". Merges would also have closed tickets that must stay open. The QA gate flagged the risk; I missed the KS-1129 move. Before
    each merge I reworded the description and confirmed Linear no longer read it as closing. No ticket was wrongly closed, and I put KS-1129 back in Backlog. PR
    descriptions now get a check for closing wording before they go up.
  - F-2, a new ticket: the #1001 gate found that in production v1 still refuses cookie-bearing callers that v2 now lets through, because the versioning redirect runs after
    CSRF. I filed it as KS-1177 (Medium) and linked it to KS-1165.
  - F-1, a follow-up PR: the gate showed my mount-order tests stayed green under two real regressions in index.ts. #1003 adds tests that import the real app; they fail
    under both regressions, which the old tests don't.

  New since the last update
  - #1002 (KS-1123): test-only pins, plus comment fixes in verification.ts. I didn't use the ticket's suggested comment wording, because it would be false for one case
    until KS-1073 lands.
  - #1004 (KS-932): in packages/shared, so every service picks it up. timeoutMs now also bounds DNS resolution. I flagged two things for the gate: a DNS timeout reports
    blocked rather than request_failed, and one test depends on wall-clock timing.

  Also worth knowing
  - Pre-push checks: every push ran 12 of 15 legs with nothing failing. Legs 3, 4 and 8 were skipped because no local stack is running, and each PR records that as not a
    pass.
  - Slips: a label typo in my own tamper runner, and an unquoted heredoc in a draft edit. Neither affected a PR, and both are noted in the records.

  Nothing is deployed. The next ticket, KS-844, starts when an approval and merge free a slot. The inbox watch is armed.
